references.text: The main account of the incident at the waters of Meribah, where Moses and Aaron failed to honor God in the sight of the people by striking the rock instead of speaking to it.
Moses is reminded again of his disobedience at Meribah-Kadesh in the wilderness of Sin, which is why he is not allowed to enter the promised land.
The first incident at Massah and Meribah where the people quarreled with Moses over water, and Moses struck the rock.
The psalmist refers to the incident at the waters of Meribah where things went badly for Moses because of the people's rebellion.
A warning not to harden your hearts as at Meribah and Massah, where the ancestors tested God.
The Lord was also angry with Moses because of the people and refused to let him enter the land.
Moses recounts that the Lord was angry with him on account of the people and would not listen to his prayer to be allowed into the land.
The prophet Ezekiel mentions the waters of Meribah-Kadesh as a boundary marker, linking it to the significance of the place.
